task: 77.44.7.D / D-06 — parallel bounded Editor fixes: interactive canvas pan, failed page-load recovery, mobile Inspector focus restoration

changes.subject: fix(editor): recover pan and page load gestures safely

slices.finding: The capture-phase Editor Pan handler ignored buttons/inputs, but the separately loaded legacy canvas-pan.js bubbling listener still began panning for every pointerdown. Interactive Canvas controls could therefore be dragged instead of activated.
slices.change: Guard interactive descendants in the legacy canvas pan controller and version its public cache URL.
slices.regression: Added a real Chromium button-inside-Canvas test proving a drag does not scroll or capture pan while the button remains clickable.
slices.local_result: Baseline test failed before the fix with scroll movement (36,24); fixed target passed 1/1. Combined pan and failed-page-load browser tests passed 2/2.

slices.finding: After a failed page GET or noncanonical document response, the previous Page Model remained visible but the page selector stayed on the failed target.
slices.change: On load failure re-render page list and current canvas from unchanged state, while showing the original error; no save or publish is triggered.
slices.regression: New browser test covers 503, malformed document, retry success, unchanged draft and no Save/Publish.

changes.subject: fix(editor): restore mobile inspector focus on panel return

slices.finding: Mobile panel switching returned focus to the opener but did not restore the Inspector control previously used; plan acceptance requires selected node, field focus and Page Model to survive Layers <-> Inspector switching.
slices.change: Remember the last focused element per mobile dock. Restore it only when it remains connected, enabled, visible, in the reopened dock, and outside hidden/inert content; otherwise focus the dock close control. Capture the current opener before closing the other dock so Escape/back restoration never points into a hidden panel.
slices.regression: New Chromium scenario seeds and selects a real text node, focuses an Inspector field, switches to Layers and back, asserts exact focus target and stable selection/draft, with zero Save/Publish writes.
